notes.title: Version 0.5.0b released!
notes.notes:
We glad to announce Ecopoiesis v0.5.0b has been released!

Key changes:
+ [Gameplay] Added levels 6-10
+ [Gameplay] Added a new type of creep. It has more HP and large infection zone which infect more farms around itself
+ [Gameplay] Added a new large minion. This minion attacks farms, disabling them until the parasite will be removed. The farms don't produce oxygen when disabled by this parasite.
+ [Gameplay] Added creep links. Destroying a creep now will also destroy all creeps in the chain towards the reactor. Also added a visual part of this link which looks like a ferroliquid coming from a parent creep to a spawned one. Please note that Large Creeps are spawned out of the link system so will not be affected by destroying a creep chain.
+ [UI] Added level info and mission time on the ingame screen.
+ [Gameplay] Remade balance on all levels.
* [Bugfixing] Fixed some minor bugs
